## Metrics

| Name | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mysql_buffer_pool_data_pages` | sum | number | The number of data pages in the InnoDB buffer pool. |
| `mysql_buffer_pool_limit` | sum | Bytes | The configured size of the InnoDB buffer pool. |
| `mysql_buffer_pool_operations` | sum | number | The number of operations on the InnoDB buffer pool. |
| `mysql_buffer_pool_page_flushes` | sum | number | The number of requests to flush pages from the InnoDB buffer pool. |
| `mysql_buffer_pool_pages` | sum | number | The number of pages in the InnoDB buffer pool. |
| `mysql_buffer_pool_usage` | sum | Bytes | The number of bytes in the InnoDB buffer pool. |
| `mysql_client_network_io` | sum | Bytes | The number of transmitted bytes between server and clients. |
| `mysql_commands` | sum | number | The number of times each type of command has been executed. |
| `mysql_connection_count` | sum | number | The number of connection attempts (successful or not) to the MySQL server. |
| `mysql_connection_errors` | sum | number | Errors that occur during the client connection process. |
| `mysql_double_writes` | sum | number | The number of writes to the InnoDB doublewrite buffer. |
| `mysql_handlers` | sum | number | The number of requests to various MySQL handlers. |
| `mysql_index_io_wait_count` | sum | number | The total count of I/O wait events for an index. |
| `mysql_index_io_wait_time` | sum | nanoseconds | The total time of I/O wait events for an index. |
| `mysql_joins` | sum | number | The number of joins that perform table scans. |
| `mysql_locks` | sum | number | The number of MySQL locks. |
| `mysql_log_operations` | sum | number | The number of InnoDB log operations. |
| `mysql_max_used_connections` | sum | number | Maximum number of connections used simultaneously since the server started. |
| `mysql_mysqlx_connections` | sum | number | The number of mysqlx connections. |
| `mysql_opened_resources` | sum | number | The number of opened resources. |
| `mysql_operations` | sum | number | The number of InnoDB operations. |
| `mysql_page_operations` | sum | number | The number of InnoDB page operations. |
| `mysql_prepared_statements` | sum | number | The number of times each type of prepared statement command has been issued. |
| `mysql_query_count` | sum | number | The number of statements executed by the server. |
| `mysql_query_slow_count` | sum | number | The number of slow queries. |
| `mysql_replica_sql_delay` | sum | seconds | The number of seconds that the replica must lag the source. |
| `mysql_replica_time_behind_source` | sum | seconds | This field is an indication of how “late” the replica is. |
| `mysql_row_locks` | sum | number | The number of InnoDB row locks. |
| `mysql_row_operations` | sum | number | The number of InnoDB row operations. |
| `mysql_sorts` | sum | number | The number of MySQL sorts. |
| `mysql_table_io_wait_count` | sum | number | The total count of I/O wait events for a table. |
| `mysql_table_io_wait_time` | sum | nanoseconds | The total time of I/O wait events for a table. |
| `mysql_threads` | sum | number | The state of MySQL threads. |
| `mysql_tmp_resources` | sum | number | The number of created temporary resources. |
| `mysql_uptime` | sum | seconds | The number of seconds that the server has been up. |
